hypotheses_and_conclusion: (s : RegularCount) (hr : ∀ r, s = .negBinomial r → 0 < r) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℕ} {lo hi : ℕ} (hlo : ∃ i, x i = lo) (hhi : ∃ i, x i = hi) (hb : ∀ i, lo ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ hi) {m : ℝ} (hm : ∑ i, (x i : ℝ) = n * m) {d : Design} {fixed w : Window} (hw : allows d fixed w) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ cells w) (hN : ∀ N, s = .binomial N → hi ≤ N) : let T := tight d fixed lo hi let K := s.resolve T let E := {p ∈ s.parent | ∀ i, 0 < s.weights p (x i)} let C := candidates x s.weights s.parent d fixed let G := fun p ↦ likelihood x (s.weights p) K.kept let a : Sum ℝ Bool × Window := (Sum.inr false, positiveWindow) let eligible := allows d fixed positiveWindow ∧ ∀ i, x i = 1 let A := {q | eligible ∧ q = a} let L := fun q ↦ if q = a then 1 else likelihood x (s.weights q.1) (cells q.2) ((∃ q ∈ C ∪ A, IsMaxOn L (C ∪ A) q) ↔ s.attains K m ∨ eligible) ∧ (∀ q, (q ∈ C ∪ A ∧ IsMaxOn L (C ∪ A) q) ↔ q ∈ A ∨ (q ∈ C ∧ IsMaxOn G E q.1 ∧ (∀ k ∈ cells q.2 \ cells T, s.weights q.1 k = 0) ∧ (eligible → G q.1 = 1))) ∧ (K.nonsingleton → ((∃! p, p ∈ E ∧ IsMaxOn G E p) ↔ s.attains K m)) ∧ (¬ K.nonsingleton → ∀ p ∈ E, G p = 1) ∧ ((¬ ∃ q ∈ C ∪ A, IsMaxOn L (C ∪ A) q) ↔ s.escapes K m ∧ ¬ eligible)
